Team / Alex,

Attaching the latest Mutual Action Plan (v1.3) and the redlined SOW. This thread is the official sales-to-CS handoff for Liminal Health (Deal DL-4721-LIM). High-level context below so CS has everything needed before the kickoff on 2027-05-18 at 10:00 PT.

Why they bought: Liminal is standardizing inference across their clinical triage product and wants predictable latency and per-token economics. They selected Redwood Dedicated with a scoped private deployment (VPC peering + SSO) and an initial 3-month pilot for two models (encoder + retrieval-augmented generation).

Committed scope (short):
- Dedicated pool (4x A100-equivalents) for pilot
- Private control plane with audit logs and KMS integration
- Streaming chat endpoints and embeddings for vector search
- Initial traffic profile: 10k requests/day, 90th pct latency target < 300ms

Open / action items for CS before kickoff:
1) Confirm MOP timeline and owners (see attached spreadsheet) — owner assignment requested by 2027-05-11
2) Collect technical contacts and access: SRE contact, VPN/VPC admin, and identity team for SSO/SCIM
3) SOW signoff and procurement timeline (attached redline)
4) Security questionnaire answers (we sent initial responses; they may follow up)

Suggested owner: Marissa, can you take primary CS ownership for onboarding? Sean — engineering touchpoint for deployment/runbook. Alex — please confirm your SRE and legal contacts and whether DocuSign sign-off is expected before the kickoff.

Attachments:
- Liminal_MOP_v1.3.xlsx (MOP with milestone owners and dates)
- SOW-Liminal_v2.docx (redlines visible; pending final sign)
- security-qa-responses.pdf (initial responses)

Notes for handoff:
- Key success metrics: latency SLOs, error rate < 0.5% per hour, and token spend target (we committed a cost-per-token guardrail in the SOW)
- Fallbacks: We will route to smaller quantized variant if Dedicated pool saturates — this is already in the technical runbook
- Billing: monthly invoice net-30; procurement expects to wrap up within two weeks of kickoff

Marissa — if you accept ownership, please reply with the primary CS kickoff owner, the deployment engineer (SE) assigned, and any pre-kickoff blockers. I will include these items in the shared drive and HubSpot deal.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
